detail: Louise deForest (ed). Stories from the Waldorf Early Childhood Association — by season and theme. WECAN Books.

name: ⭐ The Complete Tiptoes Lightly Series — Reg Down
detail: All 7 children's books plus 230+ free stories online at tiptoes-lightly.net — sorted by age and grade. The most generous free Waldorf story resource available anywhere in the world.

name: Best-Loved Folktales of the World — Joanna Cole (ed)
detail: 200 folktales from every continent. Expand beyond Grimm and Andersen to world folklore — African, Asian, Native American, South American, Pacific stories.

name: Norse Mythology — Charles Kovacs (Floris)
detail: The Waldorf Grade 4 Norse mythology reader. Creation, Odin, Thor, Loki, Freya and Baldur retold by a master Waldorf teacher.

name: ⭐ WHE — Waldorf Handwork Educators (July Conference — Woodwork Track)
detail: Waldorf Handwork Educators runs an annual July international online conference specifically including woodwork as one of the subject-specific tracks — alongside handwork, music and world languages. Experienced Waldorf woodwork teachers present pedagogy, projects and curriculum. waldorfhandwork.org/july-2025-conference

name: ⭐ Waldorf Practical Arts Training (WPAT) — Waldorf Institute of Southern California
detail: California, USA. AWSNA-accredited. 9 × six-day intensive modules over 3 years. Covers fibre arts, woodworking, metalworking and stone carving throughout the grades and their connection to child development. One of the few accredited programmes specifically covering Waldorf woodwork pedagogy. waldorfteaching.org

name: Sunbridge Institute — Chalkboards & Crafts (Annual Summer Workshop)
detail: Chestnut Ridge, New York. Annual summer workshop including practical arts. Contact Sunbridge for current woodwork-specific offerings. sunbridge.edu

name: Earthschooling — Woodworking with Kids (Digital)
detail: USA. Lesson plans and accompanying video designed for a one-week Waldorf woodworking unit — summer camp, enrichment school or homeschool group. Stories, verses and projects included. earthschooling.info

name: The Waldorf Curriculum (Rawson, Avison & Richter)
detail: Editorial Rudolf Steiner / AWSNA. The complete Waldorf curriculum K–12 — includes detailed guidance on the craft subjects including woodwork at each grade. The essential curriculum reference for any Waldorf woodwork teacher.

name: Waldorf Resources — Vertical Curriculum: Handwork and Crafts
detail: waldorf-resources.org/en/vertical-curriculum/handwork-and-crafts — The online Waldorf curriculum resource. Detailed pedagogical descriptions of crafts and woodwork across all grades including high school. Free. Essential teacher reference.

name: The Spoon Carving Handbook — various authors
detail: Several excellent spoon carving books support the Grade 6 Waldorf woodwork curriculum: Spoon by Joshua Vogel (Abrams); The Artful Wooden Spoon by Joshua Vogel; Whittling Twigs and Branches by Chris Lubkemann. Available at woodworking shops and online.

name: Lee Valley Tools (Canada/USA)
detail: leevalley.com. High-quality hand tools — chisels, gouges, planes and carving tools. Excellent resource for school tool purchases. Known for quality at fair prices. Ships North America-wide. Educational discounts available for schools.

name: Pfeil Tools (Switzerland)
detail: The gold standard for carving gouges and chisels worldwide. Swiss-made. Used in professional Waldorf woodwork classrooms across Europe. Available via pfeiltools.com and specialist woodworking retailers internationally.

name: Mora Knives (Sweden)
detail: Mora 120 (whittling knife) and Mora 164 (hook knife for spoon bowls) — the most widely recommended beginner carving knives for Waldorf classrooms. Excellent quality, affordable, safe handle design. Available from woodworking shops and Amazon worldwide. morakniv.se

name: ⭐ Waldorf Handwork Educators (WHE) — Elizabeth Seward PhD & Shellie Smith
detail: USA / International (Online). The world's leading Waldorf handwork teacher training. 2-year online programme (225+ hours), annual conferences (February, July, August), curriculum guides and video resources for every grade. waldorfhandwork.org · @waldorf_handwork_educators

name: ⭐ Teaching Through Stories: Jane and Jeremy Learn to Knit — Elizabeth Seward PhD
detail: The first book in Elizabeth Seward's series for handwork teachers, classroom teachers and home-schooling parents. Teaching knitting through story — in the Waldorf tradition. Available via WHE and waldorfhandwork.org

name: ⭐ waldorf-resources.org — Vertical Curriculum: Handwork and Crafts (Free)
detail: The most comprehensive free online Waldorf handwork curriculum reference. Detailed pedagogical descriptions for every grade from 1 through 12, including high school. waldorf-resources.org/en/vertical-curriculum/handwork-and-crafts

name: Waldorf Inspirations — Handwork Resources (Free)
detail: Janet Langley and team. Free handwork project ideas, patterns and curriculum notes for all grades at waldorfinspirations.com. Including chalkboard-linked handwork project ideas.

name: The Warp and Weft — Elizabeth Seward (Waldorfish blog)
detail: Free article by Elizabeth Seward PhD on the full arc of the Waldorf handwork curriculum — how knitting connects to maths, music, visual arts and main lesson across all grades. waldorfish.com/blog/handworkcurriculum

name: Knit for Health and Wellness — Betsan Corkhill
detail: The research-based book on knitting's measurable physical and mental health benefits. Used in WHE conferences. Confirms from a neuroscience perspective what Waldorf education has practised for 100 years. knitforlife.com

name: Earthschooling — Woodworking with Kids and Handwork Units
detail: USA. Digital lesson plans including handwork projects for multiple grades, with stories, verses and step-by-step guidance. earthschooling.info

name: Gathering Waters Charter School — The Role of Handwork in Development (Free article)
detail: A beautifully written free article on the developmental case for handwork in Waldorf education — head, heart and hands. gatheringwaterscharter.org/insights/handwork-in-waldorf-education

name: ⭐ Franziska Shelton — My Seasonal Treasury (Germany)
detail: Germany. Creator of My Seasonal Treasury — a beloved Waldorf-inspired seasonal resource site offering beautifully crafted tutorials, printable resources, crafting ideas and seasonal guides for families and educators. Tutorials include: wet-on-wet watercolour painting, nature table decorations, seasonal felt figures, beeswax modelling, window transparencies (kite paper), advent activities and seasonal recipes. Resources include: printable mushroom advent calendar (24 Waldorf-inspired prompts — recipes, verses, crafting ideas, poetry), window transparencies for each season, winter festival guide, seasonal scavenger hunts. A warm, generous and beautifully illustrated seasonal resource in the Waldorf spirit — available in English for international families. franzishelton.wixsite.com/duftdesregens

name: ⭐ Lydia Schade-Fox — Filzkunst (Germany) · 68K Instagram
detail: Germany. Felt artist, author and creative business expert. 68K followers on Instagram. Offers: FilzClub (membership community for felt artists), DIY felting kits and online felting courses. Known for exquisite Waldorf-inspired felt figures — gnomes, elves, forest fairies, birthday crowns, seasonal nature table pieces. Author of a forthcoming felting book featuring seasonal felt figures. One of the most followed German-language felt artists in the Waldorf world. @lydia.schade.fox on Instagram and Threads.

name: Tiny Wooly Worlds — Felted Playmats (@tiny_wooly_worlds)
detail: Handmade wet-felted wool playmats and nature table pieces in the Waldorf tradition. 100% natural merino wool — made entirely by hand using only water and soap. Playscapes with 3D elements — ponds, streams, tree stumps, flowers, mushrooms, woodland features. Felted animals, gnomes and fairies available separately to populate the playmat scenes. Custom orders accepted in different sizes and with different elements. Care: hand wash in lukewarm water, dry flat. @tiny_wooly_worlds on Instagram · Etsy shop also available.

name: Weir Crafts ⭐
detail: USA. Founded by Susan Weir to fund her children's Waldorf school fees. THE #1 doll-making supply shop in North America since 1989. USA-made doll skin fabric, 100% wool felt, merino wool roving, felting kits, Filges wool, DollyMo mohair hair yarn, organic cotton batting, felting needles. Ships internationally.

name: A Child's Dream ⭐
detail: USA. Pure wool felt sheets, organic wool batting for doll stuffing and crown padding, wool roving for felting, natural dyed silk and cotton. Complete handwork supply shop used by Waldorf schools worldwide. Knitting supplies, crochet hooks, embroidery floss, weaving materials.

name: Acorns & Twigs
detail: USA. Full Waldorf handwork range: DollyMo mohair doll hair yarn, organic merino wool stuffing and roving, Filges wool, doll needles, tubular gauze, facial pencils, skin-tone thread. Felting, spinning, carding, weaving, crochet, knitting, embroidery, sewing.

name: The Felting Source
detail: USA. Specialist felting supplier catering directly to Waldorf schools. Excellent quality fibres at fair prices. Texel plant-dyed wool from Germany for wool painting. New Zealand prefelt sheets (10 × 10 inch). FeltCraft kits for wet and needle felting. Also wholesale to Waldorf school stores.

name: Living Felt / Holland Felt
detail: USA. Comprehensive needle felting and wet felting supplier. Merino wool roving, core wool, wool felt sheets (Holland Felt — 100% pure wool). Large range of colours. Specialist felting equipment and tools. Good for birthday crown projects.

name: Paper Scissors Stone / Waldorf Supplies
detail: USA. Blended Merino wool roving in 17 colours. Felting kits, embroidery, seasonal Waldorf craft supplies. Class sets available for school purchase. waldorfsupplies.com

name: Alder & Alouette
detail: USA. Largest US stockist of Filges wool (full range of fairy tale wool, merino wool, yarn bundles, felt sheets). Also instruments, curriculum books, Waldorf supplies. Ships internationally.

name: The Waldorf Shop USA
detail: USA. 100% wool felt, felting kits, knitting wool, knitting needles, crochet hooks, weaving supplies, embroidery materials. Waldorf teacher-owned since 2002.

name: Bella Luna Toys
detail: USA. Natural felting kits, wool roving, knitting supplies, weaving looms for kids, embroidery kits. Curated handwork selection. Educational content on how to use each material.

name: Blue Otter Toys
detail: USA. Filges organic wool stockist. Plant-dyed Filges fibres for Waldorf handwork and felting. blueottertoys.com

name: Maplerose ⭐
detail: British Columbia, Canada. Run by Jenn from the Nelson Waldorf School community. 100% wool felt sheets (full range of colours, available by the sheet or by the meter on special order), heathered natural wool felt, seasonal felt sets (spring, summer, autumn, winter), 100% Canadian beeswax, doll-making supplies, embroidery floss, pipe cleaners, knitting supplies, felting kits. Ships internationally.

name: Nest
detail: Canada. Filges wool stockist. Natural and plant-dyed wool. Handwork supplies including Waldorf-appropriate tools and materials. nest.ca

name: Fibrecraft
detail: Canada. Wool roving, silk fibres, felting needles and supplies for needle felting and wet felting. Quality materials for fibre artists. Fast Canadian shipping. fibrecraft.ca

name: Canadian Felt Shop
detail: Canada. 100% wool felt, wool blend felt, wool roving, wool felt balls. Ships to USA via USPS. Comprehensive selection.

name: Real Wool Shop
detail: Canada. Yarns, knitting supplies, roving and felting supplies. Wool, merino, alpaca, silk, mohair. Specialty items and natural fibre range.

name: Filges (direct) ⭐
detail: Germany. The source. Bioland-certified plant-dyed wool manufacturer since 1985. Order directly or via waldorfshop.eu for best range. filges.de

name: Waldorfshop EU ⭐
detail: Ireland / EU. Full Filges range: felting wool, knitting yarn, felt sheets, fairy tale wool, weaving yarn, silk cloths, tools. Also Stockmar art supplies, instruments, toys. Ships throughout EU and UK. Large professional range.

name: Teia Education & Play
detail: Switzerland. Filges wool and broader Waldorf handwork range. Ships EU and internationally. teiaeducation.ch

name: ⭐ Stardust Concept Store — Netherlands
detail: Netherlands. "A small, Waldorf-inspired haven run by a dedicated mother and her daughter." EU. Filges plant-dyed wool including fairy tale wool, felt sheets and felting supplies — plus wooden toys, Waldorf books, sustainable clothing, seasonal decorations, crafts, lifestyle items and Waldorf-inspired postcards. A beautifully curated all-in-one Waldorf shop. Worldwide shipping. stardust.store

name: MamaOwl
detail: Netherlands. Waldorf-inspired online store. Natural fibre handwork supplies including wool felt, roving and knitting materials. Ships EU-wide. mamaowl.net

name: Babipur
detail: Wales, UK. Natural fibre handwork supplies including wool felt, roving, knitting materials and felting kits. Stocks Waldorf-appropriate fibres and tools. babipur.co.uk

name: Myriad Natural Toys & Crafts
detail: UK. Natural fibre craft supplies alongside toys. Wool felting kits, roving and handwork materials. Family-run since 1998. myriadonline.co.uk

name: Waldorfshop EU
detail: Ships to UK. Full Filges range available with reasonable shipping costs. waldorfshop.eu

name: Oskar's Wooden Ark
detail: Australia. Carries Filges and other natural wool handwork supplies alongside Waldorf toys. oskars.com.au

name: Tara Treasures
detail: Australia. Felt play mats and ethically handmade felt products. Also supplies some raw wool craft materials. taratreasures.com

name: Woolly Felters (NZ)
detail: New Zealand. Wool roving, felting supplies, wool felt sheets. NZ-based felting specialist. Good range of natural fibres.

name: The Wool Inn (NZ)
detail: New Zealand. Merino wool roving, felt and natural fibre supplies. NZ Merino is world-class quality — excellent for felting and Waldorf handwork.

name: Natural Dye Studio (NZ)
detail: New Zealand. Plant-dyed wool rovings and yarns. High-quality natural fibres. Compatible with Waldorf handwork requirements.

name: Wool & the Gang / local yarn shops
detail: South Africa has excellent local wool producers (Merino, Rambouillet, and Corriedale sheep farming is significant in SA). Search for local yarn shops in Cape Town and Johannesburg. Ask at Waldorf school craft markets for local wool suppliers known to the community.

name: YarnLove South Africa
detail: South African online yarn shop. Natural fibres including wool and wool blends for knitting and crochet. Handwork supplies.

name: Import via Weir Crafts or A Child's Dream
detail: USA suppliers ship internationally to South Africa. For Filges products specifically: waldorfshop.eu ships worldwide and is often the most cost-effective route for SA buyers.

name: ⭐ 1. Theosophy: An Introduction to the Spiritual Processes in Human Life and in the Cosmos (GA 9)
detail: Rudolf Steiner, 1904. The most accessible entry point into Steiner's worldview. Introduces the fourfold human being (physical body, etheric body, astral body, ego), reincarnation, karma, and the soul's journey after death. Short, relatively clear, and beautifully structured. Start here. Available free at rsarchive.org. Also: SteinerBooks, Rudolf Steiner Press.

name: ⭐ 2. How to Know Higher Worlds / Knowledge of the Higher Worlds (GA 10)
detail: Rudolf Steiner, 1904. Steiner's fundamental handbook for spiritual and personal development. Practical manual of exercises, stages of inner training, protective practices and grounding. Guidance on developing clairvoyant perception while maintaining intellectual rigour and psychological balance. The most widely-read Steiner book worldwide. Classic Osmond/Davy translation (Rudolf Steiner Press) widely recommended. Available free at rsarchive.org.

name: ⭐ 3. An Outline of Esoteric Science (Occult Science — an Outline) (GA 13)
detail: Rudolf Steiner, 1910. Of all Steiner's books this one perhaps comes closest to containing the whole of his spiritual teaching. Systematic presentation of his cosmology, the constitution of the human being, the evolution of the earth and humanity through cosmic stages, reincarnation and karma in depth, and the path of initiation. Dense and demanding — read slowly, with a study group if possible. Available free at rsarchive.org. SteinerBooks edition recommended.

name: ⭐ 4. The Philosophy of Freedom / Intuitive Thinking as a Spiritual Path (GA 4)
detail: Rudolf Steiner, 1894. Steiner's clearest statement of epistemology, moral autonomy and the method of intuitive thinking. The philosophical foundation of everything that follows. Argues that true freedom lies not in the absence of constraint but in the capacity to act from pure thinking — from love for the deed itself. More demanding philosophically than the others. Michael Wilson translation (Rudolf Steiner Press) widely recommended. Available free at rsarchive.org.

name: Christianity as a Mystical Fact (GA 8)
detail: Rudolf Steiner, 1902. Steiner's exploration of the Christ event as the central mystery of human evolution — seen not through faith but through spiritual-scientific investigation. Bridges ancient mystery traditions and the significance of the Resurrection for human consciousness. Rudolf Steiner Press / SteinerBooks.

name: Stages of Higher Knowledge (GA 12)
detail: Rudolf Steiner. The companion to Knowledge of Higher Worlds — on the three stages of higher cognition: imagination, inspiration and intuition. A deeper exploration of what the spiritual organs of perception actually are. SteinerBooks.

name: The Foundation Stone Meditation
detail: Rudolf Steiner, Christmas Conference 1923. The spiritual cornerstone of the re-founded Society. A meditation verse in four parts — one for each season — encompassing the whole of anthroposophy in concentrated poetic form. Read alongside an explanation (many available) — the deepest single meditation Steiner gave. rsarchive.org

name: Anthroposophical Leading Thoughts (GA 26)
detail: Rudolf Steiner, 1924–1925. Written in the final year of his life — letters to members including the Michael Letters and the cosmic thinking of humanity's last spiritual turning. Advanced but profoundly rewarding. Available free at rsarchive.org.

name: The Calendar of the Soul (GA 40)
detail: Rudolf Steiner, 1912. The 52 weekly meditation verses — one for each week of the year beginning at Easter. A living companion to the whole year. Read alongside the live verse widget in this directory. Available free at rsarchive.org/COTS. SteinerBooks print edition ISBN 0-88010-263-2.

name: ⭐ The Education of the Child (GA 34)
detail: Rudolf Steiner. The foundational essay on Waldorf education — short, accessible, essential. Covers the three seven-year developmental stages, the relationship between education and soul-spiritual development, and the principles of the Waldorf curriculum. The ideal first Steiner education text. Available free at rsarchive.org. Also published as a short standalone essay by Anthroposophic Press / SteinerBooks.

name: Study of Man / Foundations of Human Experience (GA 293)
detail: Rudolf Steiner, 1919. The foundational lectures given to the first Waldorf teachers before the school opened. The deepest account of child development and the nature of the threefold human being in relation to education. Essential for any serious Waldorf teacher or parent. SteinerBooks / Anthroposophic Press.

name: Agriculture Course (GA 327)
detail: Rudolf Steiner, 1924. The foundational lectures on biodynamic agriculture given at Koberwitz. Eight lectures. The indispensable text for understanding biodynamic farming — see the Biodynamic Agriculture section of this directory. Available free at rsarchive.org. SteinerBooks / Floris Books.

name: Nutrition: Food, Health and Spiritual Development
detail: Rudolf Steiner (ed. Christian von Arnim). Anthology of Steiner's lectures on nutrition — impact of vegetarian and meat diets, proteins, fats, carbohydrates, individual foods. The philosophical foundation for Waldorf nutrition. SteinerBooks. Also: see the Nutrition section of this directory.

name: ⭐ Rudolf Steiner: An Introduction to His Life and Work — Gary Lachman
detail: TarcherPerigee. The most readable and accessible biography of Rudolf Steiner by respected esoteric historian Gary Lachman (formerly Gary Valentine of Blondie). Places Steiner in the context of Western esoteric history. Ideal first book for anyone approaching Steiner from outside the movement. Non-partisan and intellectually serious. Highly recommended as a starting point before reading Steiner himself.

name: The Way of Anthroposophy — Florin Lowndes
detail: Floris Books. Clear, accessible introduction to the core ideas of anthroposophy for newcomers. Covers the fourfold human being, reincarnation, karma, the spiritual world and inner development. Recommended for families approaching anthroposophy through Waldorf education.

name: Rudolf Steiner: Herald of a New Epoch — Stewart Easton
detail: Anthroposophic Press. Classic comprehensive biography of Rudolf Steiner. More detailed and sympathetic than Lachman — written from within the movement. SteinerBooks.

name: Toward Imagination: Culture and the Individual — Yeshayahu Ben-Aharon
detail: Anthroposophic Press. For more advanced students — on the development of imagination as a cognitive and spiritual faculty. One of the most important contemporary anthroposophical thinkers.

name: ⭐ Rudolf Steiner Archive (rsarchive.org)
detail: The most important free online resource in the anthroposophical world. The complete digital archive of Rudolf Steiner's written works and lecture cycles — over 6,000 lectures in English translation. Searchable by GA number, keyword or topic. Free. The Calendar of the Soul tool (rsarchive.org/COTS) is also here. Maintained as a public service and charity. rsarchive.org

name: ⭐ AnthroWiki (en.anthro.wiki)
detail: The anthroposophical encyclopaedia — comprehensive articles on all aspects of Steiner's work, the Society's history, key concepts, personalities and practical fields. In German and English. One of the best research tools for serious students. en.anthro.wiki

name: Das Goetheanum Online (dasgoetheanum.com)
detail: The Goetheanum's journal — weekly content on anthroposophy, Waldorf education, biodynamic farming, the arts, social questions and the Goetheanum's own life. In German with selected English content. Free articles and research essays. dasgoetheanum.com

name: Goetheanum Lectures Online
detail: The Goetheanum regularly livestreams lectures, performances and events from Dornach. Free to watch worldwide. Check the Goetheanum events calendar at goetheanum.ch for upcoming lectures.

name: Online Waldorf Library (waldorflibrary.org)
detail: Free digital library of Waldorf education materials — articles, curriculum guides, lectures on education, research papers. Maintained by the Research Institute for Waldorf Education. waldorflibrary.org

name: SteinerBooks / Anthroposophic Press (steinerbooks.org)
detail: USA. The primary English-language publisher of Steiner's works and anthroposophical titles. Full catalogue, new releases, digital editions. steinerbooks.org · Also: the Rudolf Steiner Bookstore at rudolfsteinerbookstore.com

name: Rudolf Steiner Press / Sophia Books (UK)
detail: UK. The primary British publisher of Steiner's works and anthroposophical literature. Classic translations. rudolfsteinerpress.com

name: Camphill Movement
detail: An international network of communities for people with developmental disabilities, founded on anthroposophical principles by Karl König in 1940. Camphill communities combine residential care, Waldorf education, biodynamic farming and artistic activity in a therapeutic social environment. Over 100 communities worldwide. camphill.org

name: ⭐ Bund der Freien Waldorfschulen (BdFWS)
detail: Stuttgart & Berlin. The umbrella organisation of all Waldorf schools in Germany — over 250 schools and 600+ kindergartens. "Waldorf" and "Rudolf Steiner" are registered trademarks of the Bund. School finder, teacher training seminars directory, publications, podcasts (Waldorf.Perspektiven), job listings, news and Webshop. Contact: bund@waldorfschule.de · waldorfschule.de

name: Bundesverband der Rudolf Steiner Schulen in Deutschland
detail: The second German Waldorf school association — schools that use the name "Rudolf Steiner Schule" rather than "Waldorf School." Both associations are fully recognised. Works in close cooperation with the Bund der Freien Waldorfschulen.

name: Vereinigung der Waldorfkindergärten Deutschland
detail: Association of Waldorf Kindergartens in Germany. Over 600 member kindergartens. Mentoring, training support, quality development, publications. A growing movement — Germany needs many new Waldorf kindergartens and teachers as demand continues to rise. waldorfkindergarten.de

name: Freunde der Erziehungskunst Rudolf Steiners
detail: International aid organisation for Waldorf education worldwide — headquartered in Germany. Collects donations and passes 100% (without deducting administration costs) to Waldorf projects abroad — supporting Waldorf school development in Eastern Europe, Africa, Asia and Latin America. freunde-waldorf.de

name: ECSWE — European Council for Steiner Waldorf Education
detail: Brussels. The European umbrella organisation connecting national Waldorf associations across Europe. Policy, research, teacher education standards, publications. Secured EU operating grant 2025. ecswe.eu

name: Pädagogische Forschungsstelle beim Bund der Freien Waldorfschulen
detail: Stuttgart. The research institute of the German Waldorf school movement. Research on Waldorf pedagogy, curriculum, child development and school quality. Publications, conference proceedings and the comprehensive links network for Waldorf institutions worldwide. forschung-waldorf.de

name: ⭐ Freie Hochschule Stuttgart — Seminar für Waldorfpädagogik
detail: Stuttgart. The primary full-time Waldorf teacher training institution in Germany — located steps from the first Waldorf school on the Uhlandshöhe. Bachelor's and Master's programmes in Waldorf education. The most historically significant Waldorf teacher training institution in the world. freie-hochschule-stuttgart.de

name: ⭐ Alanus Hochschule für Kunst und Gesellschaft — Waldorf Institute
detail: Alfter bei Bonn (near Cologne). State-recognised university of art and society with a strong Waldorf education faculty. Bachelor's and Master's degrees in Waldorf education, curative education, artistic therapies, fine art, music, theatre and social work. One of the most internationally known German Waldorf academic institutions. alanus.edu

name: Seminar für Waldorfpädagogik Berlin
detail: Berlin. Full-time Waldorf teacher training seminar in the German capital. Part of the network of 11 Waldorf teacher training institutions in Germany listed by the Bund. waldorfschule.de/lernen/schul-und-seminarsuche

name: Waldorf-Ideen-Pool ⭐ FREE — Marcus Kraneburg
detail: Germany. Marcus Kraneburg's extraordinarily generous free teacher resource site — hundreds of lesson plans, main lesson book examples, teaching materials, craft ideas and pedagogical articles in German. One of the richest free Waldorf teaching resources in the German-speaking world. Used by teachers and homeschoolers worldwide. waldorf-ideen-pool.de

name: Freunde der Erziehungskunst — Fortbildungen
detail: Germany / International. The Freunde der Erziehungskunst offers professional development courses, workshops and seminars for Waldorf teachers. Also coordinates volunteer teacher exchanges worldwide — sending experienced German Waldorf teachers to developing Waldorf movements. freunde-waldorf.de/fortbildungen

name: ⭐ Verlag Freies Geistesleben — Stuttgart
detail: Stuttgart. Founded 1947 on the initiative of the Free Waldorf School of Stuttgart and the Anthroposophical Society of Stuttgart. One of the leading publishers for anthroposophy and Waldorf education — 1,100+ available books and eBooks. Motto: "Denken mit dem Herzen" (Thinking with the Heart). Subjects: Waldorf pedagogy, anthroposophy, children's and young adult books, cookbooks, creative guides, social sciences, art, natural sciences. geistesleben.de

name: ⭐ Verlag Urachhaus — Stuttgart
detail: Stuttgart. Founded 1925. Merged with Verlag Freies Geistesleben in the 1990s but continues as an independent imprint. Focus: children's and young adult books, literature, gift books, medicine, pedagogy, religious renewal and cultural history. Publisher of the erziehungsKUNST magazine. Beloved for its beautiful illustrated children's books. urachhaus.de

name: ⭐ erziehungsKUNST — Magazine (Monthly)
detail: Stuttgart (Verlag Urachhaus). The flagship German-language Waldorf education magazine. Published monthly. Provides insight into the motives of Waldorf pedagogy, articles for better understanding of children and young people, dialogue with partners and critics, a forum for parents, reviews of educational books and children's literature. Climate-neutral production. Subscription: abo@geistesleben.com · erziehungskunst.de · Instagram: @erziehungskunst

name: Rudolf Steiner Verlag — Basel, Switzerland (German editions)
detail: Basel, Switzerland. The primary publisher of Rudolf Steiner's complete works in German (the Gesamtausgabe — GA). All of Steiner's lectures and books in their original German. The definitive scholarly editions. rudolf-steiner-verlag.ch

name: Verlag am Goetheanum — Dornach, Switzerland
detail: Dornach. Publisher for anthroposophical literature from the Goetheanum. Science, arts, social renewal, education and anthroposophy. Close connection to the Goetheanum's various sections and the General Anthroposophical Society. vergam.ch

name: J. Ch. Mellinger Verlag — Stuttgart
detail: Stuttgart. Anthroposophical publisher in Stuttgart — specialising in texts on spiritual science, social renewal and Waldorf education. One of the smaller specialist publishers in the Stuttgart anthroposophical network.

name: Futurum Verlag — Basel
detail: Basel, Switzerland. Publisher of books describing seeds for future-oriented social design — without fixed doctrine, enabling dialogue and discourse. Connected to the anthroposophical impulse of social renewal.

name: Das Goetheanum — Weekly Journal
detail: Dornach, Switzerland. The international weekly journal of the General Anthroposophical Society — the most important anthroposophical journal in German. Articles on anthroposophy, Waldorf education, biodynamic farming, arts, social questions, festivals and the life of the Goetheanum. dasgoetheanum.com · Instagram: @goetheanum

name: ⭐ GAÄD — Gesellschaft Anthroposophischer Ärzte in Deutschland
detail: Germany. The German Society of Anthroposophical Doctors — the primary professional association for anthroposophic physicians in Germany and German-speaking countries. Doctor finder, publications, research, continuing education for doctors, nurses and therapists. The largest national anthroposophic medical association in the world. gaed.de

name: ⭐ Weleda AG — Schwäbisch Gmünd, Germany & Arlesheim, Switzerland
detail: Founded 1921 alongside the first Waldorf school. Germany's headquarters in Schwäbisch Gmünd — with a biodynamic medicinal plant garden. The world's leading manufacturer of anthroposophic medicines and natural cosmetics. Products include Arnica massage oil, Calendula baby care, Birch Arnica bath milk, and hundreds of medicinal preparations. Available in 50+ countries. weleda.de · weleda.com · @weleda_de

name: ⭐ WALA Heilmittel GmbH — Bad Boll/Eckwälden, Germany
detail: Bad Boll, Baden-Württemberg. Founded 1935 by Dr. Rudolf Hauschka in the anthroposophical tradition. Manufacturer of Dr. Hauschka skin care and WALA medicinal preparations. WALA's 12-hectare biodynamic garden grows over 250 medicinal plant varieties. Dr. Hauschka products available worldwide. wala.de · dr.hauschka.com

name: Gemeinschaftskrankenhaus Herdecke
detail: Herdecke, North Rhine-Westphalia. The flagship anthroposophic hospital in Germany — one of the most significant anthroposophic medical institutions in the world. Acute care hospital integrating conventional and anthroposophic medicine. University teaching hospital connected to Witten/Herdecke University. krankenhaus-herdecke.de

name: Gemeinschaftskrankenhaus Havelhöhe — Berlin
detail: Berlin. Anthroposophic hospital in Berlin. Acute care, oncology, psychiatry and outpatient services. One of the key anthroposophic medical centres in northern Germany. havelhoehe.de

name: ARCANA Arzneimittel — Munich
detail: Munich. Manufacturer of anthroposophic medicines — one of several smaller German manufacturers of Steiner-inspired medicinal preparations alongside Weleda and WALA. arcana.de

name: Witten/Herdecke University — Faculty of Health
detail: Witten. Germany's first private university — founded on the initiative of the anthroposophical movement. Faculty of Health includes the Department of Anthroposophic Medicine and integrative medicine research. Internationally recognised for innovative medical education. uni-wh.de

name: ⭐ Demeter Deutschland e.V.
detail: Darmstadt. Germany has one of the largest and most active biodynamic farming movements in the world — hundreds of Demeter-certified farms, dairies, bakeries, wineries and food producers. Farm and product finder: demeter.de — search by postcode and product type. The most comprehensive national biodynamic farm network in the world. demeter.de

name: Rapunzel Naturkost — Legau, Allgäu
detail: Legau, Bavaria. One of Germany's most beloved organic and biodynamic food brands. Founded 1974 in the spirit of ecological and social renewal. Wide range of organic whole foods — nuts, dried fruits, grains, pastas, chocolate. Many products Demeter-certified. Available throughout Germany and internationally. rapunzel.de

name: Alnatura — Darmstadt
detail: Darmstadt. Germany's leading organic supermarket chain — co-founded in the anthroposophical spirit. 140+ stores across Germany. Strong Demeter-certified product range. Alnatura products available in Swiss Migros and other retailers. Close cultural connection to Waldorf families. alnatura.de

name: Forschungsring für Biologisch-Dynamische Wirtschaftsweise e.V.
detail: Darmstadt. The German biodynamic research institute. Research on biodynamic farming methods, preparations, farm organism, soil biology and food quality. Publications and annual research reports. forschungsring.de

name: ⭐ Waldorfshop.eu — Waldorf Shop Europe
detail: Germany. The largest online Waldorf shop in Europe — comprehensive range of Stockmar art supplies, Choroi instruments, natural toys, wool, beeswax, seasonal craft materials, pedagogical books and Waldorf school supplies. Works in cooperation with the Bund der Freien Waldorfschulen and Freunde der Erziehungskunst. B2B programme for schools and kindergartens. Ships throughout Europe. waldorfshop.eu

name: ⭐ Stockmar — Wax Crayons & Paints (Celle, Germany)
detail: Celle, Lower Saxony. Founded 1931. The world's most loved Waldorf art supply brand — beeswax block crayons, beeswax stick crayons, watercolour paints, finger paints and modelling beeswax. Made in Germany from beeswax and natural pigments. Stockmar block crayons are the standard for Waldorf chalkboard drawing and children's art. stockmar.de · Available at all Waldorf shops worldwide.

name: ⭐ Choroi Instrumente — Stuttgart
detail: Stuttgart. Founded in collaboration with the Goetheanum Medical Section. The world's primary maker of Waldorf musical instruments — pentatonic flutes (pear/cherry wood), lyres, harps, glockenspiels and diatonic flutes. Choroi instruments are designed to support child development. Workshops employ people with disabilities. choroi.org · Available at waldorfshop.eu and specialist Waldorf shops.

name: Mercurius — Waldorf Art Supplies (Netherlands/Germany)
detail: Netherlands (distributed throughout German-speaking Europe). Manufacturer of Waldorf block chalk, coloured pencils, watercolours and art papers. Widely used in German Waldorf schools alongside Stockmar. Available at waldorfshop.eu and specialist suppliers.

name: Filges — Natural Wool & Felt (Heidelberg)
detail: Heidelberg. Germany's premier manufacturer of natural wool products for Waldorf education — plant-dyed fairy tale wool, wool batting, felt sheets, felting wool, wool padding and birthday crown material. Used in Waldorf kindergartens and schools throughout Germany and worldwide. filges.de · Available via waldorfshop.eu and international Waldorf suppliers.

name: ⭐ Editora Antroposófica (Brazil)
detail: São Paulo, Brazil. The leading Brazilian publisher of anthroposophical and Waldorf books in Portuguese. Steiner's collected works, Waldorf pedagogy, biography and spiritual science translated into Portuguese. editora.com.br

name: Instituto Biodinâmico — IBD (Brazil)
detail: Brazil. The main biodynamic certification body in South America. Deeply connected to the anthroposophical and Waldorf agricultural movement. ibd.com.br

name: ⭐ Editorial Antroposófica (Argentina)
detail: Buenos Aires, Argentina. The primary Argentine publisher and bookshop for anthroposophical and Waldorf education books in Spanish. Full online store covering all categories: Educación Waldorf, Antroposofía, Medicina, Literatura Infantil, Agricultura Biodinámica, Pedagogía Curativa, Euritmia and more. The go-to source for Spanish-language Waldorf books throughout South America. antroposofica.com.ar

name: Editorial Rudolf Steiner (Spain)
detail: Spain. Founded 1975 — the longest-running Spanish-language anthroposophical publisher. Rudolf Steiner's foundational works, Waldorf education, biodynamics, medicine, Christology and social science in Spanish. Serves the entire Spanish-speaking world. editorialrudolfsteiner.com

name: Editorial Pau de Damasc (Spain)
detail: Spain. A major Spanish-language anthroposophical publisher serving Spain and Latin America. Waldorf pedagogy, anthroposophy, Goethean science, curative education, eurythmy, children's stories and school materials in Spanish and Catalan. paudedamasc.com

name: Editorial Idunn (Chile)
detail: Chile. Chilean publisher of Waldorf and anthroposophical books in Spanish. Part of the growing Latin American Waldorf publishing network serving Chile, Argentina and beyond.

name: Latin American Waldorf Conference (triennial)
detail: All-Latin America conference for Waldorf educators, held every three years. Rotating host country. Organised by FEWB (Brazil) in coordination with national federations. The flagship gathering of the Latin American Waldorf movement.

name: IPMT — International Postgraduate Medical Training (Latin America)
detail: The IPMT was initiated in 2002 by Dr. Michaela Glöckler and the Medical Section at Goetheanum. Annual course weeks for physicians and licensed prescribers in AM — available across Latin America. Main countries offering or accessing IPMT: Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, Uruguay. Contact the Medical Section at Goetheanum: medicalsection.goetheanum.ch

name: Freunde der Erziehungskunst (Friends of Waldorf Education)
detail: Germany-based global support organisation. Funds teacher training programmes, social Waldorf initiatives and school development across Latin America including Brazil, Colombia, Peru and Mexico. freunde-waldorf.de/en/waldorf-worldwide/organisations-worldwide/latin-america

name: Weleda Latin America
detail: Weleda do Brasil (São Paulo) is the primary Weleda presence in Latin America. Anthroposophic medicines and skincare. Practitioner referrals available. weleda.com.br

name: IVAA Latin America Contact
detail: IVAA maintains contacts for all Latin American countries — Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Cuba, Ecuador, Peru and Uruguay. Start at ivaa.info/about/our-members to find the national association or contact person for any country in the region.

name: Anthromedics — Latin America Research
detail: Der Merkurstab published a comprehensive overview: "Latin America: Open Windows for the Future" — the history of AM development across all Latin American countries with training, political and academic achievements. Available via anthromedics.org/DMS-21242-EN

name: Centre for Creative Education (CCE) — Training hub for all Africa
detail: Cape Town, South Africa. The most significant Waldorf teacher training institution in Africa. State-accredited degrees valid across South Africa and internationally recognised at Waldorf schools worldwide. Serves South Africa and East Africa. centreforcreativeeducation.co.za

name: East African Waldorf Teacher Development Programme
detail: Training hub for Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda. 25+ years. Based at Rudolf Steiner School Mbagathi, Nairobi. Online resources: eawaldorf.com · online.eawaldorf.com

name: Freunde der Erziehungskunst — Africa Programme
detail: Friends of Waldorf Education, Berlin. Main funder and coordinator for Waldorf development across Africa. Supports South Africa, East Africa and West African initiatives. freunde-waldorf.de/en/waldorf-worldwide/organisations-worldwide/africa

name: ⭐ CCE Cape Town — Teacher Training Manuals (Africa)
detail: Centre for Creative Education, Cape Town. The CCE has produced a series of open-source teacher training manuals specifically written for the East African Waldorf context — Child Development Based on the Insights of Rudolf Steiner — used in Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda. Developed by Peter van Alphen and Ann Sharfman with funding from German development partners. Available free via eawaldorf.com and the CCE. centreforcreativeeducation.co.za

name: Southern African Federation of Waldorf Schools — Publications
detail: Cape Town, South Africa. The Federation has produced key curriculum guides for the South African context — including Curriculum: Waldorf Schools in South Africa (Peter van Alphen / Sally von Holdt, 2000) — the foundational South African Waldorf curriculum document used in schools, teacher training and development programmes across the continent. waldorf.org.za

name: Africa: A Teacher's Guide — Rudolf Steiner College Press
detail: USA/Africa. A carefully organised resource for teaching children and adolescents about African culture — songs, fairy tales, mythologies, biographies, art and recipes, divided by geographical region. Practical activities for each grade including kindergarten. Used in Waldorf schools worldwide for Africa geography blocks. SteinerBooks / Rudolf Steiner College Press.

name: Natura / Pegasus (South Africa)
detail: Anthroposophical and homeopathic medicines distributed across South Africa. Available in health stores and pharmacies. The main source of anthroposophic remedies for SA-based families.

name: CCE Sponsor a Kindergarten Teacher Project
detail: The cost to train one kindergarten teacher through the CCE is €3,000 — training one teacher enables 300 children per year to experience Waldorf-inspired education. freunde-waldorf.de/en/wow-day/projects-around-the-world/south-africa-centre-for-creative-education

name: All Africa Anthroposophic Training (biennial)
detail: Biennial gathering for anthroposophical training and community-building across Africa. Covers human development and social competence inspired by anthroposophy. Contact via Anthroposophical Society in South Africa or Freunde Waldorf Africa.

name: ⭐ Agriculture Course (GA 327) — Rudolf Steiner
detail: Spiritual-Scientific Foundations for Agricultural Renewal. The foundational text — eight lectures from Koberwitz, June 1924. Available as: hardback, paperback, and many translations. The indispensable primary text for any serious student of biodynamics. SteinerBooks · Floris Books · Rudolf Steiner Press · Also free online at rsarchive.org

name: The Biodynamic Sowing and Planting Calendar — Maria Thun (annual)
detail: Floris Books. Published annually. Maria Thun researched cosmic planting rhythms for 50+ years — this calendar gives daily root/flower/fruit/leaf day designations based on moon position. Used by biodynamic farmers and gardeners worldwide. The essential practical companion to Steiner's Agriculture Course. New edition each year from Floris Books (florisbooks.co.uk).

name: Gardening for Life: The Biodynamic Way — Maria Thun
detail: Floris Books. The accessible introduction to biodynamic gardening practice for home gardeners and families. Maria Thun's decades of research made practical. Covers preparations, planting calendar, soil, composting. Perfect starting point.

name: Farming with the Cosmic Forces — Rudolf Steiner
detail: SteinerBooks. Selected lectures on biodynamic agriculture — a more accessible anthology than the full Agriculture Course for those new to biodynamics. SteinerBooks.

name: Soil and Soul — Alastair McIntosh
detail: Aurum Press. Not specifically biodynamic but widely read in biodynamic circles — land, community, spirituality and the deep connection between healthy farms and healthy communities. Deeply resonant with anthroposophical values.

name: ⭐ Annual Agriculture Conference — Goetheanum, Dornach, Switzerland
detail: Since the first Agricultural Conference in 1925, such a conference has taken place every year to the present day. The 2025 conference drew over 700 participants from 47 countries at the Goetheanum, February 5–8, 2025. The theme was "The Earth as a Living Being" and Rudolf Steiner's Seven Life Processes. The 2026 conference (February 4–7, 2026) theme is "You Never Farm Alone — Living Communities for the Future." The world's longest-running biodynamic conference — 100 consecutive years. agriculture-conference.org

name: ⭐ Biodynamic Association (USA) — Webinars, Courses & Annual Conference
detail: USA / Online. The Biodynamic Association offers webinars and courses exploring the wisdom and practice of Rudolf Steiner's indications for biodynamic agriculture and nutrition. Each month's lesson offers practical, experiential, and artistic exercises, alongside inner development exercises. Participants can begin any time and work at their own pace. The twelve lessons cultivate our capacities to perceive, experience, and work morally with the dynamic activity of life in soil, plants, animals, the human being, and the cosmic atmosphere. Annual biodynamic conference (rotating location). biodynamics.com

name: ⭐ Threefold Community Farm — Practical Training in Biodynamics
detail: Chestnut Ridge, New York (Threefold Community — same campus as Sunbridge, Green Meadow Waldorf School, Eurythmy Spring Valley). In thirteen full-day workshops from September to June, this one-year part-time practical training covers the basic principles and timely activities of biodynamic agriculture through the seasons. In the classroom, Mac Mead and expert guest faculty introduce Rudolf Steiner's spiritual science in the context of the Agriculture Course. In the field: making and using biodynamic preparations, compost making, soil building, working with large animals, beekeeping, greenhouse work and more. Scholarships available. threefoldcommunityfarm.org

name: Pfeiffer Center Biodynamic Course — NOFA/Mass
detail: Massachusetts, USA (via NOFA/Mass). Named for Ehrenfried Pfeiffer — one of Steiner's closest agricultural collaborators. Annual series of one-day workshops September–April. Topics: The Individualised Farmscape and Pruning Fruit Trees · Seeing Nature Whole / Life Rhythms and Planting Calendar (with Craig Holdrege) · Water: H₂O or Much More? Partial scholarships available. Certificate of completion. nofamass.org

name: Josephine Porter Institute (JPI) — Applied Bio-Dynamics
detail: USA. Supporting gardeners and farmers in their practice of biodynamics since 1985. JPI provides biodynamic preparations, educational workshops, books, research and e-news updates. JPI publishes Applied Biodynamics quarterly. The primary North American source of biodynamic preparations for those who cannot make their own. jpibiodynamics.org

name: Biodynamic Association — Farmer Foundation Year Programme
detail: USA. A full foundation year in biodynamic farming practice. Workshop participation credits can be accumulated through Pfeiffer Center workshops. Comprehensive introduction to all aspects of biodynamic farm management. biodynamics.com/farmer-foundation-year

name: Demeter Training — International
detail: Demeter International coordinates biodynamic training programmes across its 63 member countries. Each national Demeter organisation offers local training, certification workshops and farm visits. demeter.net/services/biodynamic-training — find training in your country.

name: Asian Biodynamic Training and Networking Conference (annual)
detail: Asia. Annual gathering for biodynamic practitioners in Asia — October 2024 conference. Growing biodynamic movement in India, Japan, South Korea, China and Southeast Asia. Contact via Demeter International for current Asia training resources.

name: Hawthorne Valley Farm — Workshops & Apprenticeships (USA)
detail: Ghent, New York (Hudson Valley). One of North America's most celebrated biodynamic farms — run alongside Hawthorne Valley Waldorf School and the Association for Cultural Evolution. Farm apprenticeships, workshops, community education. Open farm days. Products in CSA and local markets. hawthornevalleyfarm.org

name: Emerson College — Agriculture Programme (UK)
detail: Forest Row, East Sussex, England. The leading European centre for anthroposophical and biodynamic education — Emerson College offers courses in biodynamic agriculture, Goethean science, art, Waldorf education and social renewal. Founded 1962. One-year and shorter programmes. emerson.ac.uk

name: Skandinavisk Biodynamik / Biodynamic Federation Scandinavia
detail: Scandinavia. Training, workshops and farm network across Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland. Contact via Demeter International Nordic member organisations.

name: ⭐ The Biodynamic Sowing and Planting Calendar (annual) — Maria Thun
detail: Floris Books. Published every year — the practical calendar showing root, flower, fruit and leaf days based on lunar position. Even if you cannot do the full biodynamic preparations, gardening by this calendar is deeply rewarding and produces measurable improvements in plant vitality, flavour and keeping quality. florisbooks.co.uk · Available at all Waldorf book suppliers.

name: Gardening for Life: The Biodynamic Way — Maria Thun
detail: Floris Books. The accessible home gardener's introduction to biodynamic practice — preparations, planting calendar, soil, composting, seasonal rhythm. Perfect for Waldorf families starting a garden.

name: Turtle Tree Seed (USA)
detail: A small non-profit seed company. 100% open-pollinated vegetable, herb and flower seeds. Organic and biodynamic, grown in their own seed garden and by other farmers and gardeners — all non-GMO, non-hybrid, grown without chemical inputs. turtletreeseed.org

name: Josephine Porter Institute (JPI) — Preparations by Mail
detail: USA. JPI sells biodynamic preparations by mail for farmers and home gardeners who cannot make their own. The most accessible source of high-quality biodynamic preparations in North America. Also: books, quarterly newsletter Applied Biodynamics. jpibiodynamics.org

name: Holle — Demeter Baby Food
detail: Founded in Switzerland in 1934, Holle was the first Demeter-certified baby foods brand. Approximately 80% of their products worldwide carry the Demeter seal — the highest international standard for holistic, ecological and ethical farming practices. Available internationally. holleusa.com · holle.ch

name: Weleda — Biodynamic Medicinal Garden
detail: Weleda has maintained a biodynamic medicinal plant garden since 1921 — the same year the company was founded alongside the first Waldorf school. Their products use biodynamically grown medicinal plants. A direct living link between Waldorf education, anthroposophic medicine and biodynamic agriculture. weleda.com

name: ⭐ Foodwise: Understanding What We Eat and How It Affects Us — Wendy Cook
detail: Clairview Books (2nd revised edition 2012). THE definitive anthroposophical nutrition book. Wendy Cook studied macrobiotics and Steiner's approach to nutrition and biodynamic agriculture after her daughter developed asthma. She devoted herself to cooking and teaching in clinics, communities and schools, and later studied for a degree in Waldorf Education at Plymouth University. Foodwise presents a cornucopia of challenging ideas, advice and commentary informed by the seminal work of Rudolf Steiner. Chapters cover: The History of Nutrition · Agricultural Methods · The Fourfold Human Being · Grasses and Grains · The Threefold Plant · Carbohydrates and Sweeteners · Bread and Bread Making · The Nightshade Family · Legumes · Milk and Dairy · Fats and Oils · Salt · Minerals · Herbs and Spices · Coffee, Tea and Chocolate · Water. Ends with practical tips on planning menus, children's food, sharing meals and recipes. "A book that unites taste and transcendence." — Satish Kumar. "At last here is a book which tells you the whole truth about food!" SteinerBooks / Clairview Books. ISBN 9781905570232

name: ⭐ The Biodynamic Food & Cookbook: Real Nutrition That Doesn't Cost the Earth — Wendy Cook
detail: Clairview Books. Wendy Cook takes us on a journey through the four seasons with more than 150 delicious recipes based on many years of working with biodynamic nutrition. Explains the principles behind biodynamic methods and places them in the context of food and cooking through the ages. Considers the ethics of food, the foundation of a balanced diet and includes sections on breads, sauces, salads, desserts, drinks and children's food. Illustrated with hundreds of colour photographs. A permanent companion for every Waldorf-inspired kitchen. ISBN 9781905570010

name: ⭐ Nutrition: Food, Health and Spiritual Development — Rudolf Steiner
detail: SteinerBooks (anthology, ed. Christian von Arnim). In this carefully collated anthology, Rudolf Steiner considers nutrition in the light of his anthroposophic spiritual-scientific research. He explains the impact of raw food, vegetarian, and meat diets; the effects of protein, fats, carbohydrates, and salts; individual foods such as potatoes, beets, and radishes; and the impact of alcohol and nicotine. The source text — Steiner's own lectures on nutrition collected in one volume. Essential reading for anyone wishing to understand the philosophical foundation. SteinerBooks / Rudolf Steiner Bookstore.

name: The Dynamics of Nutrition — Gerhard Schmidt
detail: Biodynamic Literature. Gerhard Schmidt discusses vegetarian nutrition from an anthroposophical perspective in depth. Explores why plant-based nourishment cultivates inner forces that make us more capable of work and thought. One of the most thorough anthroposophical treatments of nutrition available. Available via SteinerBooks and AbeBooks.

name: Cooking for the Love of the World — Anne-Marie Fryer Wiboltt
detail: Awaking Our Spirituality through Cooking. A deeply practical and spiritually grounded guide to cooking from an anthroposophical perspective. Covers the grain rhythm, seasonal cooking, preparing food with reverence and the relationship between food and spiritual development. Biodynamic ingredients, whole grains, seasonal recipes. One of the most used practical Waldorf cooking books.

name: Nourishing Wisdom: A Mind-Body Approach to Nutrition and Well-Being — Marc David
detail: Harmony Books. Though not specifically Waldorf, widely recommended in anthroposophical nutrition circles for its exploration of the relationship between food, consciousness and emotional life — deeply resonant with Steiner's own indications. Explores how the state in which we eat is as important as what we eat.

name: The Waldorf School Snack & Meal Book
detail: Various Waldorf school community publications. Several Waldorf schools have produced their own recipe books for school meals and snacks — often reflecting the grain rhythm, seasonal cooking and biodynamic principles. Check your nearest Waldorf school or AWSNA for school-produced cookbooks.
url: Via local Waldorf schools · AWSNA · waldorfeducation.org

name: Simply in Season — Mary Beth Lind & Cathleen Hockman-Wert
detail: Herald Press. Not specifically anthroposophical but deeply aligned with Waldorf nutrition principles — recipes organised by season, locally sourced whole foods, whole grains throughout, biodynamic principles in spirit. Widely used in Waldorf family kitchens as a practical seasonal companion.

name: The Moosewood Cookbook — Mollie Katzen
detail: Ten Speed Press. The beloved whole food vegetarian cookbook that generations of Waldorf families have used as their kitchen bible. Not anthroposophical, but whole grains, seasonal vegetables and nourishing plant-based cooking throughout. Has been in Waldorf family kitchens worldwide since 1977.

name: Nourishing Traditions — Sally Fallon
detail: New Trends Publishing. Widely used in Waldorf and anthroposophical family circles — fermentation, traditional food preparation, bone broths, whole grains, raw dairy. Not specifically Steiner-based but deeply resonant with his indications on traditional and living food preparation. Particularly valued for fermented foods, sourdough bread and traditional grain preparation.

name: ⭐ Arne Kaiser — My Chalkboard (Netherlands / USA)
detail:
Born in Amsterdam, the Netherlands. Attended Waldorf school in Bergen, Norway from age 10. B.A. in Waldorf Education. Taught at the Geert Groote School in Amsterdam, then at Pine Forest School (Flagstaff, Arizona) from 2002. Author of My Chalkboard — the definitive guidebook on Waldorf chalkboard art. A guided tour of the Waldorf curriculum of Grades 1–8, illuminated with almost 400 chalk drawings from actual lessons. The book offers background information on chalkboard work, more than 100 colour examples of blackboard drawings, and practical guidelines and thoughts for working with each grade. An indispensable inspiration and reference for the Waldorf teacher or homeschooling family. Also author of:
• Personal Verses: 60 Verses for Children in the Waldorf School — birthday and personal verses for children
• The Little Red Hen — a Waldorf Grade 1 play adaptation (cast of 10–40)
• Extensive chalkboard photos shared on Pinterest: pinterest.com/arnekaiser

My Chalkboard is available at Blurb Books (blurb.com) and Amazon.
url: blurb.com — search "My Chalkboard Arne Kaiser" · pinterest.com/arnekaiser

name: ⭐ Narsingh Khalsa — Waldorf Art & Teacher (@khalsaart)
detail: USA. Experienced Waldorf teacher and prolific chalkboard artist. Shares his artistic journey across classroom chalkboard drawings, Etsy resources and published books. His Facebook page "Waldorf Art and Teacher" has over 49,000 followers. His Instagram @khalsaart and Pinterest boards are among the most-referenced collections of Waldorf classroom chalkboard drawings on the internet — spanning all grades from Grade 1 to Grade 8. His drawings are known for their warmth, colour depth and seasonal resonance. Resources available via Etsy shop TeachingWaldorf — main lesson book pages, chalkboard drawing guides, curriculum planning tools, seasonal activities and grade-by-grade resources. The Etsy shop has been reviewed as "a very helpful chart," "wonderful resource for forms for the age" and "beautifully made." A dedicated source for Waldorf teachers and homeschoolers seeking chalkboard inspiration for specific curriculum blocks.
url: Instagram: @khalsaart · Facebook: Waldorf Art and Teacher (49K followers) · Etsy: TeachingWaldorf

name: ⭐ Wondergarten — Nathaniel & Lisa Santa Cruz (USA)
detail:
Puyallup, Washington, USA. Founded 2022. Wondergarten opened its doors in fall 2022 as an in-home preschool. Their content struck a chord and sparked a viral response — families from around the world were captivated by what they were doing, inspiring many to recreate something similar in their own homes and communities.

Lisa Santa Cruz is creator of the Wondergarten Curriculum — the director, teacher and designer of all Wondergarten products, services and materials. Nathaniel Santa Cruz is the creator of The World of Wondergarten — the author, composer and illustrator behind all the songs, stories and artwork throughout the curriculum. A former U.S. Marine and later Program Manager for Google Maps and Senior GIS Analyst at Joint Base Lewis-McChord, Nathaniel left his career to support his family's preschool. Creating characters, composing songs for lessons, and illustrating stories on classroom chalkboards became a new source of joy and fulfillment.

What Wondergarten offers:
• Wondergarten Curriculum (published 2024) — non-academic, seasonally focused early childhood curriculum. Stories, songs and chalkboard illustrations. Commercial licensing available for schools and homeschool co-ops.
• Music Theory Chalkboard Print — hand-illustrated chalkboard art including diatonic and pentatonic scales, note values, grand staff, circle of fifths, key signatures. Beautiful for any music room.
• Children's stories featuring four gnomes who live in the backyard — original characters with original songs
• Community on Mighty Networks — a vibrant global community of families using the Wondergarten approach

Contact: wondergarten.net · Instagram: @wondergarten

name: ⭐ @waldorfblackboard — Danijela Zura (23K followers)
detail: Instagram. "Waldorf chalkboard drawings from 🌎 Your help and inspiration." Run by Waldorf teacher/consultant @danijelazura. 23,000 followers, 1,581 posts. A curated international collection of Waldorf chalkboard drawings from teachers around the world — seasonal nature boards, festival boards, curriculum-specific drawings for all grades. One of the richest chalkboard inspiration accounts on Instagram. The account actively credits contributing teachers, making it a true community resource.

name: @chalkdrawingsofwaldorf (Instagram)
detail: Instagram. A dedicated collection of Waldorf chalkboard drawings from teachers worldwide. Seasonal, curriculum-linked and celebratory boards. A community gathering place for Waldorf teacher-artists sharing their board work. Search alongside #waldorfchalkboard and #waldorfblackboard for the widest inspiration.

name: Steve Simonak — Chalkboards & Main Lesson Books Workshop (Sunbridge)
detail: USA. 5th Grade class teacher at Brooklyn Waldorf School. 26 years at Hawthorne Valley Waldorf School. BFA in Painting (Pratt Institute), Waldorf Teaching Certificate (Alkion Center). Teaches the annual summer workshop at Sunbridge Institute: "Techniques and Skills for Creating Beautiful Drawings in the Grades: A Focus on Chalkboards and Main Lesson Books." Covers chalk techniques, colour mixing, seasonal and curriculum-linked drawing for all grades. Annual July weekend workshop at Sunbridge, Chestnut Ridge, NY. sunbridge.edu

name: waldorfteacherresources.com — Chalkboard Gallery
detail: USA / International (free). A teacher-contributed resource site with a dedicated Chalkboard Drawings gallery — main lesson boards from Grades 1–8, sorted by grade and subject. Contributions from Waldorf teachers worldwide. One of the most comprehensive free online chalkboard reference libraries. waldorfteacherresources.com

name: Waldorf Inspirations — Chalkboard Idea Gallery
detail: USA (free). Janet Langley and team. The Waldorf Inspirations website includes a curated Pinterest boards gallery with samples of chalkboard drawings and main lesson book pages for many curriculum blocks — EC through Grade 8. Thousands of ideas. waldorfinspirations.com

name: Waldorf at Work — Meredith Floyd-Preston (Substack)
detail: USA. Experienced Waldorf class teacher and writer. Substack newsletter Waldorf at Work covering practical classroom art, chalkboard drawing tips, main lesson book titles, hand-lettering strategies and painting by grade. Honest, self-deprecating and deeply practical — written from the perspective of a non-artist Waldorf teacher who has had to develop her skills consciously over years. Chalkboard and main lesson book articles include step-by-step video guides. waldorfatwork.substack.com

name: ⭐ Waldorfish — Robyn Beaufoy & Brian Wolfe (Australia)
detail: Australia. Trained Waldorf teachers with 25+ years in art and education. Online courses for homeschoolers and teachers: Waldorf Art for Beginners (includes chalk technique basics and a complete chalk landscape drawing lesson, plus DIY chalkboard instructions); Weekly Art Foundations (step-by-step weekly art curriculum); Diving Deeper; Weekly Art and Beyond (32 lessons for high school age, tools to become your own artist). Free online chalkboard inspiration gallery. waldorfish.com

name: Gail Lescher BFA — Prairie Moon Chalkboard Video Workshops
detail: USA. Waldorf master teacher with BFA. Prairie Moon Waldorf School produced two landmark video workshops with Gail Lescher: Chalk Board Drawing Lesson (100-minute video, all skill levels) and Advanced Chalkboard Drawings (full-day workshop, 4+ hours video — techniques and a series of drawings building confidence and skill). So well received that Gail was immediately invited back for a second session. Purchase via: prairiemoon.org/training-videos · Contact: videos@prairiemoon.org

name: Gnomes & Acorns
detail: Canada. Waldorf-inspired online store. Toys from Women's Cooperatives in Brazil, Romania and Nepal. Wooden toys from Germany. Mercurius Canada art and music supplies. Weleda health care. "SEE BEAUTY. CREATE ART. LOVE READING. SUSTAIN NATURE."

name: Maplerose
detail: BC, Canada. Waldorf arts and crafts store. Handwork kits: beeswax candle making, needle felting, wet felting, doll making, embroidery, knitting, spinning. Run by Jenn from Nelson Waldorf School community. Heart-felt, family-run.

name: Fairy Shadow (Etsy/Website)
detail: California, USA. Tania's Waldorf babies, mini critters and small handmade pieces. An unmistakable and much-loved personal style.

name: Sienna Academy
detail: Sunshine Coast, QLD, Australia. Art therapy training and individual painting sessions. Anthroposophical Liane Collot d'Herbois painting therapy approach. iARTe recognised.

name: The Acorn and Oak
detail: Melbourne, Australia. Handmade peg dolls, gnomes and bunnies from wood and hand-dyed wool felt. Melbourne-based Waldorf maker.

name: 🇩🇪 Germandolls — Ulla Seckler
detail: Colorado USA (German-born). German-style Waldorf pocket dolls, blanket dolls and cuddle babies in the German Waldorf aesthetic. Cotton velour + natural sheep wool. Small home studio batches. Etsy: germandolls

name: 🇷🇴 Wood Pecker Factory — Romania
detail: Bucharest. Hand-crafted wooden animals, trees, princesses and knights — similar to Ostheimer. African animals, sea creatures, birds, farm animals. Ships internationally. Etsy: WoodPeckerFactory

name: 🇺🇦 Waldorf World — Ukraine
detail: Dnipro. Needle-felted gnomes, fairies, fairy houses, animals, fruits, vegetables and birthday crowns. Real pine cones, moss, snail shells, beading. International shipping. Etsy: WaldorfWorld

name: 🇷🇺 Green Taiga — Russia
detail: Novosibirsk. Waldorf-inspired animals and trees from alder wood. Non-toxic paints, linseed oil and wax. Great character through carving. European and American shipping. Etsy: GreenTaiga

name: 🇦🇺 Niniani Creations — Australia
detail: NSW, Australia. Wet-felted play mats and wool felted gnomes and peg people with stunning magical headpieces. Local ethically farmed natural fibres. Free Australian shipping. Etsy: NinianiCreations

name: 🇦🇺 Deb's Steiner Dolls — Australia
detail: NSW, Australia. Full-size Waldorf and Steiner dolls and rainbow gnomes. Hand-dyed 100% wool coats stitched with hand-dyed cotton. Each one uniquely beautiful. Etsy: DebsSteinerDolls

name: 🇧🇪 @dollbelge ⭐ — Viktoriya Vashchenko (Belgium)
detail: Belgium. 215,000 followers. Viktoriya handcrafts organic Waldorf dolls from the Kingdom of Belgium. 11 years of making — 5 years building a global community. Organic cotton fabrics, natural wool, beeswax cheeks. Collaborates with Daniela Drescher (beloved Waldorf children's book illustrator) for exclusive printed fabrics. DIY making kits designed for all skill levels. Every creation comes with a signed Certificate of Authenticity. PDF tutorials, beginner kits and finished dolls. Worldwide shipping.

name: 🇧🇷 Evi Dolls — Women's Cooperative, São Paulo, Brazil ⭐
detail: São Paulo, Brazil. "Atelier de Bonecas Evi." Founded 1988 as a small business teaching handicrafts to single mothers from poor families — allowing them to work at home while caring for their children. People with disabilities were later also included. Dolls are handcrafted from pure cotton and stuffed with pure soft wool, with hair of soft wool, mohair or cotton. Classic Waldorf-style simple expressions. Available internationally via Nova Natural, Gnomes & Acorns (Canada), Bella Luna Toys (USA), Tree Hollow Toys and many Waldorf retailers worldwide. A purchase directly supports Brazilian women's economic independence. Search: Evi Dolls or Evi Waldorf Dolls.
url: Search: Evi Dolls Waldorf · via international Waldorf toy shops

name: 🇵🇪 Q'ewar Project — Andahuaylillas, Peru ⭐
detail: Andahuaylillas (near Cusco), Peru. A social and economic anthroposophical initiative working with indigenous Quechua women in the rural Andes highlands. Founded 2002 by Waldorf art teacher Julio Herrera and his partner Lucy. 47 women and 4 men work daily; 20 more women come from surrounding farms on Saturdays. Each doll takes 5 days to make. Natural materials only: cotton cloth body stuffed with pure sheep's wool, hair made strand by strand from pure alpaca fiber, traditional Peruvian clothing hand-dyed with natural tints, knitted booties and sweaters from alpaca yarn, backstrap-loomed ponchos. The project also runs a preschool (Wawa Munakuy — "giving love to the children"). Sold worldwide to the USA, Europe and Australia. A Q'ewar doll is truly a "doll for life." Website: qewar.com · Australian distributor: qewar.com.au

name: 🌍 Africa — Natural Fibre Toys & Makers
detail: Africa has a rich tradition of handcraft and natural fibre work — but established Waldorf-specific natural toy makers with a strong online presence are still emerging. The best way to find African Waldorf makers is: (1) Contact the Centre for Creative Education (CCE) Cape Town directly — they know the community of makers in Southern Africa. (2) Search #waldorfafrica #steinerafrica #naturaltoyssa on Instagram. (3) Contact Michael Oak Waldorf School or Constantia Waldorf School craft markets — Cape Town Waldorf school fairs regularly feature local natural toy and craft makers. (4) The Hekima Waldorf School (Tanzania) community may also have local makers — contact via hekimawaldorf.com

name: ⭐ 🇳🇱 Stardust Concept Store — Netherlands
detail: Netherlands. "A small, Waldorf-inspired haven run by a dedicated mother and her daughter." Sustainable children's clothing, wooden toys (Grimm's, Grapat, Glückskäfer and more), Waldorf books, crafts, seasonal decorations, lifestyle items and Waldorf-inspired postcards. Everything thoughtfully curated for quality, sustainability and Waldorf values. Worldwide shipping. stardust.store
